description.value: Cates Hill Nature Park is a municipal nature reserve on Bowen Island, operated by Bowen Island Municipality and accessible to visitors arriving via the Horseshoe Bay ferry to Snug Cove. The park offers natural green space and trails within cycling distance of the ferry terminal, making it a straightforward destination for cyclists exploring the island. As a publicly managed reserve, it provides a quiet natural contrast to the busier waterfront area near the ferry landing.
